answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, split across independent auditors. Work waits on the inlet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the garden of the next round. Reaching the grove of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
